usefulness.rationale: The dossier body is empty; only identity anchors remain, giving minimal facts (MIT president since Jan 2023, Duke provost 2014-2022, cell biologist with a 1989 Rockefeller PhD). No extracted statements exist, so there are no overclaims to flag, but there is also no substantive content: no evidence of what she has actually done, no explicit acknowledgment of what is unknown (the dossier simply says nothing), and one unextracted, unclassified source. A reader learns the bare identity but little about her actions, and could only prepare for the most superficial meeting.
